title: Dave Farley - Vibe Coding - Is this really the best we can do? - AI Native DevCon June 2026
description:
The programming landscape is undergoing a seismic shift, and AI is at the epicenter. Even if AI development halted today, its influence on programming methodologies is irreversible. The key now is understanding how best to integrate these powerful tools, despite the current market being akin to the wild west, rife with hype and skepticism alike. Natural languages, while intriguing, fall short compared to established programming languages in providing the control we seek.

Dave Farley, founder and CEO of Continuous Delivery Ltd. brings his expertise to this discussion at AI Native DevCon June 2026. Known for his deep insights into software development practices, Farley delves into the challenges and opportunities AI presents. He explores the evolution of programming languages and ponders the future landscape of coding in an AI-dominated era.

What we cover:
• The revolution in programming sparked by AI
• Why current programming languages surpass natural languages
• The challenges of using AI tools effectively
• The potential future of programming
• What ideas might help control software development in the future?
• How hype and naive claims are shaping the AI tools market
